html: Mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) cascades pass a signal through three kinases in a row: a MAP3K phosphorylates a MAP2K, which phosphorylates a MAPK. RAF1 starts the ERK cascade (MEK1 and MEK2, then ERK1 and ERK2), which activates transcription factors such as ELK1. Oxidative stress activates ASK1, which feeds two stress cascades, MKK4 and MKK7 to the JNKs, and MKK3 and MKK6 to the p38 kinases; JNK activates AP-1 (c-Jun with c-Fos) and p38 ATF2. These factors drive the inflammatory genes that particles induce in airway and immune cells.
